review_type: blinded machine-agent content review; no human review claimed

blindness.limitation: Shared filesystem; blindness enforced by reading only assigned packet and contract, not by OS sandbox isolation.

method: All 300 packet source/extraction pairs were compared. A local sentence-difference script supported full coverage; predictions depend on packet content, never example index or concealed labels. Repeated transformations were inspected as content groups. Source attribution was independently considered beyond sentence normalization.
systemic_issues: Substantive diversity is low: all 300 sources use CLM-A planned 11 and CLM-B reported 17, one source span, two references, and three short stock gap/uncertainty sentences. Ten domain noun/unit substitutions and twenty wrappers do not establish broad reasoning diversity.

Sixty insufficiency candidates consist of twenty repetitions each of three conspicuous refusal/ambiguity marker strings. Forty provide no actual candidate extraction; twenty explicitly announce their own ambiguous referent. Real corrupted, truncated, conflicting, or partially attributable source/extraction content is absent.
OMISSION conflicts with the instruction that incomplete extraction requires refusal; narrow transport incompleteness versus semantic omission must be distinguished explicitly.
Speaker and sender attribution is silently stripped. Six otherwise exact comparisons are conservatively OMISSION with MATCH alternative until formatting/provenance scope is defined.
Generic certainty substitutions sometimes delete a different attribute uncertainty; simultaneous additions and omissions have no category precedence. Unsupported dates can also be contradictions.
Required references point to the same two claims even when comparing uncited gap statements, limiting evidence-selection challenge.
Context-only distractor is the same unrelated 900-unit record with a fixed date throughout. This is a narrow test of context isolation.

Some sources contain unclear entry referents, third entries without corresponding claim text, and no-first-entry statements alongside two claims. Such ambiguity can be faithfully preserved but should not be confused with independently established factual contradiction.
The adapter rejects refusal envelopes while prompt permits refusal; review predictions use INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE as requested, not as a supported finding enum.
